intro: Alyissia is a kaldorei warrior trainer stationed inside the hollow boughs of Aldrassil in Shadowglen. She guides newly awakened night elf warriors in the fundamentals of martial combat, helping them harness raw strength and discipline to defend their nascent world tree.

p: Standing within the sheltered sanctuary of Aldrassil, Alyissia instructs young night elves who feel drawn to the path of steel and shield rather than nature magic or the priesthood. While the kaldorei military is traditionally renowned for its Sentinels and stealthy archers, the perilous state of modern Kalimdor requires resolute frontline fighters. Alyissia teaches foundational techniques, ensuring that fresh recruits can direct their battle fury, master their stances, and withstand the aggressive wildlife and corrupted grells encroaching on Shadowglen.
